verified_key_information_units.information: FY 2025 delivered strong financial performance with revenue increasing 33.9% to EUR 1.837 billion, EBITDA rising 60% to EUR 232.6 million, though net profit decreased to EUR 71.9 million due to one-off consolidation effects from Tallink Grupp.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Key Figures of Q4 2025 table showing revenue, EBITDA, and net profit for 12 months 2025 vs 2024; accompanying note explains net profit decrease attributable to one-off effects from Tallink Grupp consolidation in 2024.

candidate_sentences.text: Infortar Group’s unaudited 2025 results showed stronger operating performance but lower net profit than in 2024, when the initial consolidation of Tallink generated significant one-off effects.
Consolidated revenue reached EUR 1.837 billion, compared with EUR 1.372 billion in 2024.
EBITDA rose to EUR 232.581 million from EUR 145.415 million, and the EBITDA margin improved to 13.4% from 10.6%.
However, net profit declined to EUR 71.969 million from EUR 193.670 million, while profit attributable to the parent’s shareholders decreased to EUR 72.662 million from EUR 191.253 million.
The report attributes the year-on-year decline in net profit mainly to one-off effects associated with Tallink’s initial consolidation in 2024.

verified_key_information_units.information: Q4 2025 revenue was EUR 417.4 million and EBITDA EUR 42.6 million, with net profit turning positive at EUR 14.1 million compared to a loss of EUR 11.9 million in Q4 2024.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Key Figures of Q4 2025 table (Q4 2025 vs Q4 2024 columns for revenue, EBITDA, and net profit); Events in Q4 2025 section lists factors impacting Q4 financial results.

candidate_sentences.text: Fourth-quarter performance improved operationally.
Revenue was EUR 417.438 million, compared with EUR 446.168 million in Q4 2024, while EBITDA increased to EUR 42.604 million from EUR 27.892 million.
Operating profit improved from a EUR 6.792 million loss to a EUR 19.842 million profit, and net profit rose from a EUR 11.988 million loss to EUR 14.141 million.

verified_key_information_units.information: Maritime transport segment saw passenger volumes fall 0.9% annually but Q4 EBITDA improved to EUR 27.6 million; Tallink sold the cargo vessel Sailor and extended the Silja Europa charter until January 2027.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report section on Maritime Transport (passenger and cargo unit volumes); Events in Q4 2025 section details Q4 maritime results and specific events (vessel sale, charter extension).

candidate_sentences.text: Maritime transport generated full-year revenue of EUR 765.288 million and EBITDA of EUR 124.187 million, below 2024 levels of EUR 785.822 million and EUR 175.181 million.
Tallink carried 5.531 million passengers during the year, down 0.9%, while cargo units fell 19.2%.
Results were affected by low consumer and business confidence, geopolitical tensions, the sale of the cargo vessel Sailor, and lower financing repayments and interest expense.

Key developments included the acquisition of Oisu Biogaas, continued Rail Baltica and Depo construction, a multi-year agreement for 12 LNG cargoes, and the extension of Silja Europa’s charter agreement to January 2027.

verified_key_information_units.information: Energy segment increased sales volumes by 7% to 4.8 TWh in Q4 despite lower regional consumption; Elenger secured a multi-year LNG supply agreement for 12 cargoes and expanded battery storage capacity in Latvia while planning further developments in Estonia.

candidate_sentences.text: Energy was the largest contributor to full-year revenue and EBITDA.

Key developments included the acquisition of Oisu Biogaas, continued Rail Baltica and Depo construction, a multi-year agreement for 12 LNG cargoes, and the extension of Silja Europa’s charter agreement to January 2027.

details.completeness_justification: All core material information from the fixed criteria is adequately represented in the candidate summary. K1 covers full-year financial performance, K2 covers Q4 financials, K3 covers maritime segment details including vessel sale and charter extension, K4 covers energy segment performance and agreements, K5 covers real estate projects, K6 covers agriculture expansion, K7 covers liquidity and debt metrics, and K8 is missing but is of MEDIUM importance and does not materially change the overall understanding. The summary captures the main picture with no material omissions.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent. It consistently explains the year-on-year changes in financial metrics, attributes net profit decline to one-off effects from Tallink's consolidation (S1, S7), and provides logical segment breakdowns without contradictions. The organization flows from consolidated results to segment performance and balance sheet changes. While there is a minor decline in maritime transport revenue/EBITDA (S15), this is contextualized by external factors in S18. No arithmetic contradictions exist because the summary does not claim segment figures are exhaustive additive components of consolidated totals. All statements logically support each other without gaps or repetitions that materially reduce clarity.
